label: Menopause check-ins
h1: Perimenopause and menopause check-ins, on your calendar

items.b:
Five minutes, once a month:
• How many hot flushes or night sweats this month, roughly?
• Sleep: better, same or worse?
• Periods: dates, flow, any gaps or unusual bleeding?
• Mood, brain fog, joint aches, anything new?

Write it down while it's fresh. Unusual bleeding, especially after periods have stopped, is worth raising with a clinician promptly.
Quick log for the week: sleep, hot flushes, mood, energy, cycle. Patterns are much easier to spot (and to explain at an appointment) when they're written down weekly instead of remembered.

items.t: Before your appointment: prepare your summary
